summary: Client is Blair Endodontics and Microsurgery; project replaces https://www.bemdentalcare.com/.
Website redesigned with 'Soft Modern Wellness' aesthetic for dentist practice. Uses Astro framework with component-based architecture.
Main components created: DentistHero (navbar + hero), Services (6 service cards), About (company info + credentials), Testimonials (patient reviews), CTA (call-to-action), Footer (contact + links).
Design system: Color palette uses Ivory (#FAF9F6), Sage (#A8C5B5), Sage Dark (#2A5F4F), Terracotta (#E8AE90), Warm Gray (#E8E4DF). Typography: Plus Jakarta Sans (headings) + Manrope (body).
Typography system is fully consistent across all components. All components include Google Fonts @import. All headings use Plus Jakarta Sans, all body text uses Manrope.
In this environment, Node child_process spawn/exec fails with EPERM, which breaks Astro/Vite builds that call exec("net use") on Windows.
